Name: Bonster's Crops Restyled
Author: x7eventy7
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/BLupZwo.png[/img]﻿
This mod features restyled sprites for all 54 field crops and 68 tree crops from Bonster’s Combined Crops. It also includes detailed resprites for the growing stages of both field plants and trees. After going through five major iterations, I finally achieved a result that I’m happy to share. Some of the sprites are from the talented 6480 and 0torin, but I have meticulously edited them to ensure they align seamlessly with my style. In creating this mod, I focused on making the sprites look as close to vanilla stardew as possible. I also heavily focused on ensuring each crop is well represented and looks like it does in real life. Another important design choice was to make the crop sprites whole, with no missing pieces or cuts made to the crops.
 
[font=Tahoma][size=4]Want sapling and seed sprites that match these new crop sprites[/size][/font]? Check out [font=Tahoma][size=4][font=Tahoma][size=4][b]Standardized Seed Sprites[/b][/size][/font][/size][/font][/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=4][font=Tahoma][size=4]
﻿● [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21305]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21305[/url][/size][/font]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wbISYFz.png[/img]﻿
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=4]1. Install the latest version of [i]"[b]SMAPI﻿",[/b][/i][b][i]"Content Patcher" & "Bonster's Combined Crops & Recipes"[/i][/b][/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=4]
2. Download this mod and unzip it into [i][b]"Stardew Valley/Mods"[/b][/i]
3. Run the game using [i][b]"SMAPI"[/b][/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RMo1XU0.png[/img]
◆ Ensure each crop looks realistic
◆ Match the style of vanilla Stardew Valley
◆ Whole crop sprites with no missing pieces
◆ Include detailed resprites for growing stages that match the crop

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rgYlcA5.png[/img]﻿
